prompt: Create a bounded preview-only redesign of the existing record-review screen: retain only its sidebar visually and replace the rest of the main composition. Current behavior reads the same primary record and exposes the same secondary evidence in an on-demand overlay; keep its data meanings, input/state/outcome semantics and accessible reachability. The current overlay presentation may be restyled or recomposed. Comparable products omit this evidence view. Use Product Design, preserve the existing capabilities through mapped controls/states, and produce the declared base and overlay previews without code or runtime authority. A full visual replacement must not become a different product, and the base bitmap need not display the overlay content.
